name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text input in three density-aware sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid outside a Field; inside a Field, data-invalid comes from its validation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The input; data-slot="input" and data-size name it.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Focused: a ring of ring.width in color.ring, offset by ring.offset.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid value: the danger border. Inside a Field the same style follows data-invalid.

states.name: invalid-in-field
states.description: Invalid inside a Base UI Field (its validation sets data-invalid).

accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one.
Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface.
Mark errors with aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at the message; the danger border is not the only signal.
The border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's outline.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring.
